classifications.rationale: The recital only recounts earlier presidential and Tariff Commission determinations and identifies statutory authority; it does not itself direct an actor or presently alter duties or other legal consequences.

The President presently makes the statutory determination that the specified tariff modifications and continuations are required or appropriate; the determination occurs in this segment and serves as a legally consequential predicate for carrying out the trade agreement.
classifications.evidence: I determine that the modification or continuance of existing duties or other import restrictions and the continuance of existing duty-free or excise treatment hereinafter proclaimed are required or appropriate

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory finding that suspension of the specified marking proviso is required; the finding occurs in this segment as a legally consequential predicate under the cited statutes.
classifications.evidence: I find that the suspension of the effectiveness of the proviso to Section 304(a) (3) (J) is required

classifications.rationale: The President directly makes the listed tariff treatments effective and modifies the Tariff Schedules as of January 1, 1968, so the legal consequences arise by force of the proclamation itself on that date.
classifications.evidence: the Tariff Schedules of the United States are modified, effective on and after January 1, 1968
